VSkills – Test Your Skills, Own Your Future
Vskills helps you earn a professional certification without undergoing any formal training or classroom teaching and opens ways for new career opportunities.
Vskills is a "skills testing" and certification exam by - ICSIL, a JV of TCIL, A Govt of India Undertaking and DSIIDC, A Govt of NCT Delhi Undertaking. ICSIL is one of the largest manpower companies of the government of Delhi.
How It Works
Visit our website (http://www.monsterindia.com). Browse through our 'Career Services'. Click on Vskills Certifications and choose your industry and the certification suitable for your career. Fill in your details and choose the nearest examination centre among our Test Centres. You can order and pay online using our secure online ordering system. Once you confirm your details and order, you will receive an invoice in your mail. Next, your admit card and study material will be delivered to your address of correspondence. Prepare for the exam. Appear for the examination with admit card. Get the certification.
Advantages At A Glance
A Vskills certificate serves as an impartial endorsement of your professional knowledge in your resume. It adds value to your professional skills and makes them more sellable, enabling you to package yourself for success. It offers you an opportunity to be certified in areas where you are not formally educated. It opens multiple avenues in various industrial sectors, paving ways for brighter career opportunities. It does not require any time commitment since there is no classroom teaching involved. It's just a test.
What's More CVs of certified professionals are flagged on Monster India (http://www.monsterindia.com) as 'Vskills Certified Candidates' and are shared with top employers. Psychometric Tests
With a majority of employers using aptitude tests as a critical part of their recruitment process, you must ensure that you are well prepared. They serve as the tool to assess candidates on behavioral dimensions.
Monster in collaboration with Central Test brings you scientifically validated psychometric tools to help you get an insight into your personality & career. Central Test is a leading provider of online tests and objective assessments with offices in London, Paris and Hyderabad.
With our online psychometric tests, you can determine your areas of improvement and can see how well you perform. Monster India offers a comprehensive selection of psychometric tests designed for:
